projects.name: ER CV Generator
projects.description: Resume generator that tailors a CV to a job description without inventing content. ASP.NET Core monolith (.NET 10) with a Blazor Server UI and a REST API, shipped as one Docker service.
highlights: Rule-based relevance scoring (skills 50%, keywords 30%, seniority 20%) that selects and reorders real experience and never fabricates content
Skill dictionary and job-post parser tuned on a dated corpus of 194 real job posts, reading the posted seniority level correctly in 91% of them
PDF rendering with PuppeteerSharp and DOCX with OpenXML, with page-fit enforcement for one- or two-page CVs
7,500+ automated test cases (unit, API, PDF and DOCX documents) plus Playwright end-to-end tests run in GitHub Actions CI
